name: San Ramon 2017

venue.name: Dougherty Station Community Center
venue.address: 17011 Bollinger Canyon Rd, San Ramon, CA 94582

information:
Competitor limit: 160. 

Online registration is a flat $18.75 fee and closes a week before the event. 

**You may also register at the competition day, with a cost of $20.**

Tentative events: 4x4x4 Cube Blindfolded, 5x5x5 Cube Blindfolded.

Competition held in the Ridge View Room.
